launches.body:
**TL:DR:** TaxGPT AI Tax co-pilot automates tax research, client communications, and document collections for accounting and tax firms, increasing their productivity and profitability by 10x. [Learn More](https://www.taxgpt.com/)

\
📜 **Introduction and Backstory**:\
Hi everyone, We are [Kashif](https://twitter.com/ChKashifAli) and [Isabella](https://linkedin.com/in/imaceda), co-founders of TaxGPT. After we faced a tricky tax decision. We created TaxGPT. Little did we know that this tool would quickly become a go-to research assistant for accountants.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83384&key=user_uploads/1748881/e70fc62d-7a7c-4a62-8836-2b8dcbb83d54)

**🛑 The Problem:**

There is currently a shortage of 340k accountants in the USA. Accountants are overworked and leaving the profession; not enough new professionals are joining it.\
\
**💡 The Solution:**

TaxGPT helps accountants work smarter, not harder. We automate client communications, tax research, replying to IRS notices, capturing leads, and collecting documents so accountants can focus on what truly matters. 📈💼\
\
🔍 **How it works?**\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yyMywFYDnzA>

**🙏 The Ask:**

Please introduce us to your accountants or any family members who are CPAs, tax lawyers, enrolled agents, or tax preparers. Here’s a quick blurb.\
\
“_Hey There,\
I wanted to introduce you to TaxGPT, an AI co-pilot that can help you boost your productivity and profitability by 10x. It’s designed for accountants and tax professionals, and it’s already making waves in the industry. Check it out at_ [_taxgpt.com_](http://taxgpt.com)_”_
